import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure output directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# 1. Load Data
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

TARGETS = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# 2. Preprocessing
print("Preprocessing text...")


def clean_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        text = text.lower().strip()
        return " ".join(text.split())
    return ""


train["clean_text"] = train["comment_text"].apply(clean_text).fillna("")
test["clean_text"] = test["comment_text"].apply(clean_text).fillna("")

# 3. Feature Extraction
print("Vectorizing text with TF-IDF...")
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    max_features=35000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    min_df=2,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    token_pattern=r"\w+|\d+",
    dtype=np.float32,
)
X_train_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(train["clean_text"])
X_test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(test["clean_text"])

y_train = train[TARGETS].values.astype(np.int8)

# 4. Validation Split
print("Creating validation split...")
idx_tr, idx_val = train_test_split(
    np.arange(len(train)), test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y_train[:, 0]
)

X_tr = X_train_tfidf[idx_tr]
y_tr = y_train[idx_tr]
X_val = X_train_tfidf[idx_val]
y_val = y_train[idx_val]

# 5. Model Training & Prediction
print("Training LightGBM classifiers...")
VAL_PREDS = np.zeros((X_val.shape[0], len(TARGETS)))
TEST_PREDS = np.zeros((X_test_tfidf.shape[0], len(TARGETS)))

MODEL_PARAMS = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "learning_rate": 0.04,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "max_depth": 9,
    "min_child_samples": 30,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "feature_fraction": 0.7,
    "bagging_freq": 1,
    "is_unbalance": True,
    "verbose": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "force_col_wise": True,
}

for i, col in enumerate(TARGETS):
    clf = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**MODEL_PARAMS)
    clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr[:, i], eval_set=[(X_val, y_val[:, i])], verbose=False)

    VAL_PREDS[:, i] = clf.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    TEST_PREDS[:, i] = clf.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)[:, 1]
    print(f"  Completed training for {col}")

# 6. Evaluation
print("Computing validation metric...")
auc_scores = []
for i in range(len(TARGETS)):
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], VAL_PREDS[:, i])
    auc_scores.append(auc)
    print(f"  {TARGETS[i]} ROC AUC: {auc:.5f}")

MEAN_AUC = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"\nValidation Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {MEAN_AUC:.5f}")

# 7. Submission
print("Saving submission...")
submission = sub.copy()
submission[TARGETS] = TEST_PREDS
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Successfully saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
